weakness: Four store-added third-party scripts run on every page including checkout; one from a vendor no longer used; no rule on what may be added
remediation_plan: Remove all store-added scripts from checkout; delete the coupon script; approved script list with owner and reason for other pages; turn on the provider's checkout script restriction
milestones: 2026-09-15 coupon script removed; 2026-10-15 checkout free of store-added scripts and approved list in place
resources_required: Store Manager and freelancer time (about 4 hours)

weakness: No detection of unauthorized changes to checkout page scripts or security headers; a script changed version between captures unnoticed
remediation_plan: Subscribe to a payment page monitoring service that checks the checkout page as a customer's browser sees it and texts the Store Manager on any change; targeted risk analysis sets the check frequency; response steps in the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-10-31 service chosen; 2026-11-15 live with alerts tested

weakness: No inventory of terminals, tablets, store phone, network devices, SaaS services, or scripts; no terminal serial numbers
remediation_plan: One-page inventory including terminal make, model, serial number, location, and P2PE status reconciled with the provider; review monthly with the account review

weakness: Shared cashier code; former cashier's code active 4 months; freelancer full administrator; no approvals, reviews, or monitoring
remediation_plan: Personal POS codes; account and last-day checklists; content-only role for the freelancer; monthly review against the payroll roster; factory reset of the retired tablet
milestones: 2026-07-21 former cashier code disabled; 2026-09-30 personal codes and checklists; 2026-10-15 freelancer role changed; 2026-10-31 first monthly review
resources_required: Store Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Store Manager dashboard login, freelancer online store login, 3 mailboxes, and the firewall login accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA (authenticator app) for every dashboard and online store login above cashier, every mailbox, and the MSP's firewall and backup logins; payout changes limited to the Owner
milestones: 2026-09-15 dashboard and mailboxes; 2026-10-15 freelancer and MSP logins with screenshots
resources_required: Staff time; MSP labor (included in contract)

weakness: No time limit for removing access; codes, Wi-Fi password, and store phone code not changed when people leave; no exit reminder
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-004) including Wi-Fi password and store phone code changes and a signed card data and confidentiality reminder
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-09-30 Wi-Fi password changed

weakness: Flat staff network; firewall logs not reviewed; a port was open to the CCTV recorder
remediation_plan: MSP closes the CCTV port (done 2026-08-14); separate Wi-Fi networks for payment devices and tablets, office devices, and cameras and sensors; MSP monthly report includes blocked-traffic highlights

weakness: No security or privacy training; no tamper training for Cashiers; no phishing awareness
remediation_plan: Yearly 30-minute session for all staff (card data rules, terminal tampering, phishing, reporting); tamper check card at each register; quarterly phishing exercises for the 3 office users
milestones: 2026-09-30 tamper cards posted; 2026-10-31 first session; 2026-12-31 first phishing exercise

weakness: No incident reporting rule; the 24-hour provider notice term unknown to staff
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 and 4.4 on a card at each register and in the back office; wallet cards for the Owner, Store Manager, and Bookkeeper with the provider's incident line; covered in training

weakness: No service provider list or responsibility matrix; no agreement with the freelancer; provider AOC never read; MSP evidence not received
remediation_plan: Service provider list with PCI DSS responsibilities; freelancer agreement (security, data use, deletion, 10-day breach notice); yearly AOC and SOC 2 check (P09); MSP evidence of MFA and technician list
milestones: 2026-09-30 freelancer agreement and deletion confirmation; 2026-10-31 MSP evidence; 2026-11-30 provider list and matrix

weakness: Office PC backup never restore-tested; security documents in the suite not backed up; platform data never exported
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder; restore test twice a year; monthly export of the item file and customer directory; policies and records copied to the backed-up folder
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-10-31 first monthly export
resources_required: MSP labor (about 1 hour); Store Manager time

weakness: Review and update frequency not defined at assessment; no targeted risk analyses
remediation_plan: Yearly update each July under POL-02 A.2; targeted risk analyses for terminal inspection frequency and payment page check frequency
milestones: 2026-11-15 targeted risk analyses; 2027-07-31 first yearly update

weakness: No monitoring; an administrator login without MFA could reach payout settings and the only signal is an email to the Owner after the change (new finding)
remediation_plan: Platform alerts for new users, payout changes, and settings changes to the Owner and Store Manager by text; weekly activity log check; Bookkeeper checks daily deposits against sales
milestones: 2026-09-15 alerts on; 2026-10-15 payout rights limited to the Owner; 2026-10-31 weekly check in use
